Dear shareholders,
2025 was a year of steady progress for Northgate Robotics. Revenue reached USD 2.7 billion, up 3.1% on 2024, and our operating margin was 13.0%. I want to thank our employees, customers and partners for their commitment throughout the year.
Our Collaborative Robots segment was the main driver of growth, with revenue up 7.5%. We continued to invest in our robots and in the digital tools our customers use every day, while keeping a close eye on costs. We opened new facilities and expanded our sales teams in several markets.
Our strategy remains unchanged. Northgate Robotics Inc. designs and manufactures robotic arms, motion controllers and machine-vision systems for automotive, electronics and food-processing manufacturers. We want to be the partner of choice in each of our markets, to grow faster than our industry and to convert a high share of our earnings into cash. Our balance sheet gives us the flexibility to invest through the cycle.
Looking ahead, we see both opportunities and risks. Demand in some of our end markets remains uncertain, and inflation in wages and materials has not fully eased. We will stay focused on what we can control: serving our customers well, improving productivity and developing our people.
Sincerely, Liam Ferreira Chief Executive Officer

Dear shareholders,
2024 was a year of steady progress for Sablewood Retail. Revenue reached USD 2.3 billion, up 3.7% on 2023, and our operating margin was 9.0%. I want to thank our employees, customers and partners for their commitment throughout the year.
Our Stores segment was the main driver of growth, with revenue up 7.3%. We continued to invest in our products and in the digital tools our customers use every day, while keeping a close eye on costs. We simplified our organisation and moved more of our support functions to shared service centres.
Our strategy remains unchanged. Sablewood Retail Inc. sells apparel, footwear and home goods through stores, its website and wholesale partners for consumers and department-store partners. We want to be the partner of choice in each of our markets, to grow faster than our industry and to convert a high share of our earnings into cash. We will keep returning surplus cash to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.
Looking ahead, we see both opportunities and risks. Demand in some of our end markets remains uncertain, and inflation in wages and materials has not fully eased. We will stay focused on what we can control: serving our customers well, improving productivity and developing our people.
Sincerely, Olivia Petrov Chief Executive Officer

Our Established Products segment was the main driver of growth, with revenue up 20.0%. We continued to invest in our medicines and in the digital tools our customers use every day, while keeping a close eye on costs. We completed a multi-year upgrade of our core systems.
Our strategy remains unchanged. Corvane Pharma Ltd. discovers, develops and markets prescription medicines for hospitals, specialty pharmacies and wholesalers. We want to be the partner of choice in each of our markets, to grow faster than our industry and to convert a high share of our earnings into cash. Our balance sheet gives us the flexibility to invest through the cycle.
Looking ahead, we see both opportunities and risks. Demand in some of our end markets remains uncertain, and inflation in wages and materials has not fully eased. We will stay focused on what we can control: serving our customers well, improving productivity and developing our people.
